defects.expected: Valid gitSha and sourceIdentity from the build.
defects.actual: gitSha is null and sourceIdentity is 'unknown'. This means the build process failed to capture or propagate the commit hash, classifying the deployment as NOT_PROVEN.

defects.description: Malformed JSON in login endpoint returns HTML error page instead of JSON.
defects.expected: A standard JSON error response (e.g., {'error': 'Bad Request'}).

defects.description: Project directory unavailable despite project registration.
defects.expected: The Argus endpoints should return the status and modes for registered projects.
defects.actual: The project 'twenty-argus-live-20261020' (ID: '8aab9c01-6dba-42d1-8e3d-a5de50fc0523') is returned by /api/projects/overview, but any requests to Argus endpoints using that ID fail with 'PROJECT_DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABLE'. This suggests the underlying volume or directory structure mapping is broken for this deployment.

comparison: All documented endpoints in /api-docs are present and respond correctly, matching the Express route registrations. However, functionality relying on project directories is completely broken.

remediation.action: Investigate build scripts (likely generate-provenance.sh or build-identity.ts fallback) in the Hugging Face Docker pipeline to ensure gitSha and build context are correctly captured and injected into the final image, as they are currently returning null/unknown.

Investigate the storage volume and project directory mapping. Projects are registered in the database/state, but their underlying directories in /app/data/projects are missing or inaccessible to the Express server.
Add a custom error handler in Express for syntax errors (e.g. from body-parser) so that malformed JSON payloads return a structured JSON response instead of the default Express HTML error page.
